openings.text: Mind the sunny corner. What do you need?

closings.text: Back to finding odd jobs and stranger thoughts, then.

lines.text: I had a thought once. Left it somewhere safe, probably.
If you find my thought, tell it I was looking useful.
A nice stick can be many things if nobody important is watching.
Hello. I was keeping this corner company.
I found a button once. No wall, just ambition.
Where am I going? Usually somewhere nearby, once I remember why.
I carried an empty bucket all morning. Very light work. Very confusing.
My joke wandered off, but it promised to be funny if it returns.
Your hat looks like it is thinking harder than you.
I tried following my shadow, but it got behind me somehow.
A job sounds useful. I am saving usefulness for the right moment.
I once put bread in a chest and called it planning. Nobody argued.
I can be silly from over here. Over here feels better.

pacify.text: Fine. I was getting tired of being angry anyway.
I counted, then forgot, then counted again. It should be {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
No. Even I know this is not fixed.
